accepted_plan_properties: The five declared inspected-file hashes, source tree, Phase 4 plan hash, and 399-path/58-family inventory match their exact referenced inputs.

The ten defect categories have concrete source support. The missing test targets, docs build/output drift, timeout default, malformed TOML snippets, DataSource attribution, processor token, index omissions, Python 3.12 cluster recipes, floating KaTeX references, and case mismatch in the gradient leakage URL are real bounded findings.

The mandatory core command uses the valid mandatory profile and test-model-search group. That group includes test-base, mandatory DP/MPC/RL dependencies, and ptflops. tests/conftest.py separates MLX and Lighteval collection, so the plan correctly avoids calling the core command complete optional qualification. Keep explicit Python 3.13 provisioning and preserve the focused scheduler target.

D1 reuses accepted install/build tooling and requires a real focused scheduler run, TOML parsing, strict build, exact serve-command smoke, local links, and rendering checks. Full core evidence may be reused for a prose-only slice within its actual source bounds.

D2 is a conservative 3.13 preparation/submission template. Shell syntax and local target checks can validate the template, while actual module, wheel, CUDA, network, model cache, account, and cluster execution remain unqualified. No credentials or submission are needed for this correction.

D3 confines dependency changes to three exact CDN references and permits local initialization edits only after reproduction. Direct-load and Material instant-navigation browser evidence remain required before D3 browser acceptance; a strict build or HTTP fetch alone cannot meet that gate.

Existing deployment/tooling/CI/manifests, archived source and accepted archive prose, family runtime/config files, and family READMEs remain with their existing owners. Generated docs/site output is a validation artifact, not authored source. No placeholder README, archive command modernization, unapproved retirement, or unrelated dependency churn is authorized.
The plan leaves wider example and chapter support claims pending until accepted source-bound family receipts; TOML parsing, imports, and docs builds are not behavioral support evidence.
